title: Six open PRs make the same prompt.md step 0 fix; a CODEOWNERS-gated file invites a new copy every run
problem: Every run that reads prompt.md step 0 hits `fatal: couldn't find remote ref security-alerts` (the branch does not exist) and files a PR that edits prompt.md. prompt.md is in .github/CODEOWNERS, so each PR waits for the owner and none merges; the next run sees the same error and opens another copy. Duplicate-search by title does not stop it because each title is worded differently.
evidence: open PRs on 2026-11-01 with the same fix: #12408, #12405, #12399, #12395, #12236, #12038 (mcp list_pull_requests state=open)
`git fetch origin security-alerts` fails on main at 056a581e; prompt.md step 0 still has no fallback
change: Owner: approve one of the PRs (suggest #12408, newest) and close the other five, or create the security-alerts branch by running security-alert-queue.yml once. Agents: when step 0 fails with a missing ref, treat the queue as empty and do not edit prompt.md.
metric: open PRs whose title mentions the security-alerts branch
